project_proof_route: Descend the specific normalized-cocycle map to actual deformation classes. Compose it with the local-ring square-zero-point construction and Poincare pullback; prove linearity via coefficient naturality. Prove finite dimensionality of the actual cotangent at a rational point of a locally finite-type scheme and dualize by evaluation. Prove normalization, uniqueness, and compatibility with actual curve pullback at the line-bundle deformation level. Instantiate on the Jacobian and its actual Frobenius twist, and use checkpoint 16 to identify independent V with the cocycle of the Frobenius-pulled-back deformation.
